model.state_set: ResolutionCycle states satisfying the Seed resolution invariants
model.transition_relation: delta(state, command) produces a canonical result or rejects with unchanged state

profile_boundary: Federation topology, execution, evidence acquisition, memory, planning, storage, durability and cryptographic providers are extension or implementation responsibilities.
rejection_obligation: A rejected command MUST preserve canonical state and state root.
resolution_obligation: UNKNOWN may narrow only to ACCEPT or DENY, or remain UNKNOWN while moving through an explicitly authorized acyclic Resolution Authority chain.
